mapper.sql: id, quote_no, inquiry_id, buyer_tenant_id, supplier_tenant_id, unit_price, total_price, supply_quantity, currency, delivery_days, delivery_terms, valid_until, remark, attachment_key, status, is_winning, submitted_at, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quote WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND ( buyer_tenant_id = #{tenantId} -- 采购方能看全部 OR supplier_tenant_id = #{tenantId} -- 供应商只看自己 ) ORDER BY total_price ASC
SELECT FROM quote WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE quote SET unit_price = #{unitPrice}, total_price = #{totalPrice}, supply_quantity = #{supplyQuantity}, currency = #{currency}, delivery_days = #{deliveryDays}, delivery_terms = #{deliveryTerms}, valid_until = #{validUntil}, remark = #{remark}, attachment_key = #{attachmentKey}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND supplier_tenant_id = #{supplierTenantId} AND status = 'pending' AND is_deleted = 0
